answer: Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 37 submissions per epoch. Cosignatures are collected in kernel, verified in tide, and reef names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. The attacker spends 85 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
